name: notrest
displayName: Not Rest Inc. — ORACLE session harness
description: A session harness by Not Rest Inc. — the scaffolding a working Claude session runs inside, not a pile of skills. Discipline is auto-anchored into every session by the SessionStart hook: a verification-first contract (probe before believing, prove at the consumer, label the unverified, bank before stopping). Delegation is an arrangement rather than an afterthought — agentswarm keeps the seat on decompose/judge/gate and puts the work on explicit-Opus lanes, receipted by an append-only spend ledger that makes the model-routing policy checkable instead of merely asserted. The estate writes itself: COORD.md records what every prompt landed and COORD-AGENTS.md auto-indexes every agent that finishes, so the trail survives compaction, crashes and model changes. Continuity carries across sessions — handoff files, a live line back to the predecessor session, and a successor escort window. And the harness grades itself: a shipped eval suite runs the rules against real sessions. Riding on it, twenty-eight natural-language-invocable skills from intake to handoff: oracle (six-question intake + skill routing + the CLAUDE.md foundation), researcher, marketresearcher, explainer, decider, factcheck, watch (facts have shelf lives: a watchlist of load-bearing cited claims re-verified on a cadence with factcheck rigor into a dated drift log; scheduling via the scheduled-tasks MCP where present, always owner-confirmed), introspect (validated workspace self-reports), game-forge (playtested playable games), gpt (chat-first GPT lane: guided setup, persistent chats, verified background jobs, director-safe --once), chatroom (shared Claude+GPT work rooms over append-only files), compile (the workflow compiler: a zero-token scanner mines the estate for work done three or more times, a seat-run ritual moves its stable parts into an isolated, fair-benchmarked runtime — script owns procedure, the model keeps only judgment), archivist (a greppable index over every dossier the project has produced — consult before re-spending a search budget), eval (law conformance as static fingerprint — eight checks over the shipped files in 0.08s at zero model tokens, replacing a 13-minute-per-pass external runner), refuter (the adversarial reviewer as a contract: narrow brief, six-rung attack ladder, CONFIRMED needs a reproduction), doctor (the read-only self-check: frontmatter, manifests+tombstone, count drift, hooks, estate integrity, install freshness, gitignore anchors, render stamps — every FAIL carries its fix command), draft (the outbound verb: dossier -> the thing you send, [fact] traced and labeled, [framing] listed, a draft is never sent), recap (the trail turned into the decision story: narrated timeline + cited decision map from COORD/COORD-AGENTS/git/spend), graph (script-built Obsidian-style file graph per project + a merged all-projects view for a PM session), spend (the append-only model-spend ledger), stepbystep, actionplan (copy-paste runbooks), critic, director (chains skills into pipelines), fable-director (runs the '3 devs and a relay' multi-session arrangement), agentswarm (the fast delegation arrangement: any seat — Fable or Opus — plus concurrent in-session Opus lanes, the harness as the wire), sessionend (continuity files + a live cross-session handoff line), and fable-mode — the full discipline contract, loadable on demand. Every working skill ships auditable background + plain-language dossier outputs, a --quick mode, honesty labels backed by real tiered sources, explicit search budgets, and a self-check before finishing.
